fullContentHtml:
HPSC Food Safety Officer FSO Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 45 Posts - Complete Details

Haryana Public Service Commission (HPSC) has announced the Recruitment 2026 notification for 45 Food Safety Officer posts. Eligible candidates can submit their online applications from 19 September 2026 to 28 September 2026. Eligible candidates can apply through the official website, hpsc.gov.in.

Important Dates

  • Start date to apply : 28.09.2026
  • Last date to Apply : 19.10.2026 up to 5:00 PM
  • Date of Publication of Advertisement : 19.09.2026
  • Opening Date for Submission of Online Applications : 28.09.2026
  • Closing Date for Submission of Online Applications : 19.10.2026 up to 5:00 PM
  • Closing Date for Deposit of Fee : 19.10.2026 up to 5:00 PM
  • Category of Candidates : Fee (Rs.)
  • OSC, DSC, BC-A (Non-Creamy Layer), BC-B (Non-Creamy Layer), ESM, EWS, and women candidates of Haryana : 250/-
  • DESM candidates of Haryana belonging to their vertical category (OSC, DSC, BC-A NCL, BC-B NCL, ESM, EWS) : 250/-
  • DESM candidates of Haryana belonging to UR category : 1000/-
  • All remaining candidates : 1000/-

Application Fee

  • Post Name : Food Safety Officer (Group-B)
  • Pay Scale : ₹9300-34800 + GP 4200, FPL-6 (Cell-1) ₹35,400/-
  • Start date to apply : 28.09.2026
  • Last date to Apply : 19.10.2026 up to 5:00 PM
  • Closing Date for Deposit of Fee : 19.10.2026 up to 5:00 PM
  • Scheduled Castes of Haryana : 5 years
  • Persons who have worked/are working on ad hoc, contract, work-charged, or daily wages basis in a Haryana Government Department/Board/Corporation, including Government-aided institutions : Relaxation equal to the number of completed years on the equivalent post, subject to a maximum age of 52 years, and only where such relaxation has not been previously availed for a regular appointment
  • Persons of Haryana with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) with at least 40% disability : NIL
  • OSC, DSC, BC-A (Non-Creamy Layer), BC-B (Non-Creamy Layer), ESM, EWS, and women candidates of Haryana : 250/-
  • DESM candidates of Haryana belonging to their vertical category (OSC, DSC, BC-A NCL, BC-B NCL, ESM, EWS) : 250/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
